caption: The drawing depicts a tall, free-standing grandfather clock composed mainly of wood with a rich brown, wood-grain finish. The clock has a rectangular base with slightly outward-angled feet at each corner and gold-colored trim at the corners of each section. Above the base, the body of the clock features a long, vertical wooden panel, framed with beveled edges and bordered by a lighter trim. The clock face section includes a square, glass-encased portion that holds a large circular clock dial displaying black Arabic numerals, an hour hand, and a long minute hand, as well as a smaller subdial above the center. The clock face is set on a white background, bordered at the top by a semicircular arch featuring a floral design in shades of purple, blue, yellow, and green. The top of the clock case is adorned with a broken arch pediment, gold finials, and curved wooden decorations. The background is a plain, light beige color with slight discolorations at the edges.
title: Clock
